name: Words of the High Chief
label: Quest
description: Words of the High Chief: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.
He is part of a group known as the Emerald Circle, druids that are committed to their work in Felwood, healing the land from the corruption.
Kelek has much experience with the furbolgs in Felwood, and may be able to tell you more about the log.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Emerald Circle is friendly to all, traveler. What can I do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, if you let me examine this for a while, I might be able to translate it for you.
When I am able to look over this fully, I will send word to you.
Thank you for sharing this with me, friend. Very little is known about the Winterfall furbolg.
